gloss: nominal, in name only, empty title

definitions.explanation: Having a name, title, or status without the corresponding substance, power, or reality. Something that exists only on paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}になっている。
examples.english: That committee has become nominal (exists in name only).

examples.japanese: {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}な⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to review rules that exist only on paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{実権|じっけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{副会長|ふくかいちょう}→副会長：20469_fukukaichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{握|にぎ}っている→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: The chairman is nominal; the real power is held by the vice chairman.

notes:
TYPE: ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound)

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧ (having a name) + ⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧ (no substance)
- {有|ゆう} (have) + {名|めい} (name) + ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (substance, reality)
- Literally: "having name, without substance"

USAGE AS NA-ADJECTIVE:
- {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}な⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧ (a law in name only)
- {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}な⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧ (a nominal system)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become nominal)
- {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (nominal existence)
- {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{化|か}す→化す：29802_kasu⟧ (to become empty of substance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有名無実|ゆうめいむじつ}: in name only (negative - implies lacking substance)
- ⟦{名実|めいじつ}→名実：29801_meijitsu⟧⟦{共|とも}に→共に：03468_tomoni⟧: both in name and reality (positive - complete alignment)

USAGE:
Often used for:
- Organizations or committees that no longer function
- Titles or positions without real authority
- Rules or agreements that aren't enforced
- Leaders who are figureheads
